title: Thinning the Giant Wasps
summary: Giant wasp sign has been found at the edge of Redwater: paper nests under the eaves and stung livestock. Hamo Loomis wants 3 of them dealt with.
offer_text: "The giant wasps have come closer to Redwater each night: a drone that carries across the yards. Go to the edge and thin them out, before someone is hurt."
turn_in_text: "Quieter already. I will sleep tonight. A little."

stages.title: Go to the edge of town

objectives.text: Go to where the giant wasps were seen
Tell Hamo Loomis it is done

relationship.label: Kept the giant wasps from the edge
